verdict.rationale: Flutterwave documents several local payment methods: M-Pesa, OPay e-wallet collection, direct bank account charge, ACH, and bank-transfer virtual accounts. Its online checkout has a "smart payment ordering system," which suggests multiple methods are offered in one flow. However, the pack never mentions Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects or BNPL, and never states that all methods come through a single integration. Missing for 10: Apple Pay support, Google Pay support, BNPL, explicit bank-redirect flows, documentation that all methods are enabled from one unified checkout/API integration, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, I can offer digital wallets and local payment methods (Apple Pay, Google Pay, bank redirects, BNPL) from the same integration
